basic_identification.full_title: Specification for Indicating Bolts for Use in Public Baths and Lavatories (First Revision)
basic_identification.sector_category: Civil Engineering / Builder's Hardware (approved by the Civil Engineering Division Council and finalized by the Builder's Hardware Sectional Committee of the Bureau of Indian Standards)

scope.summary: This standard prescribes the requirements for materials, dimensions, nominal sizes, manufacture, and operational types of indicating bolts fitted to doors in public baths and lavatories for showing whether they are engaged or vacant.

certification_and_marking.standard_type: Product Specification (Builder's Hardware / Door & Window Fittings)
certification_and_marking.certification_status: Voluntary / Statutory. While traditionally voluntary, builder's hardware and door fittings are frequently subjected to statutory state government PWD procurement schedules and National Building Code mandates requiring conformity to IS standards. Precious metal hallmarking is completely inapplicable to alloy indicating bolts.

requirements.detail: The operation of the indicating bolt must be achieved by one of the following two standard mechanical methods: a) Gear work, or b) Displacement.

Indicating bolts are classified and manufactured in two standard nominal sizes: Size 1 and Size 2. Other customized dimensions are permissible if mutually agreed between the manufacturer and the buyer.

As illustrated in the typical design sketch (Fig. 1), the indicating bolt assembly comprises the following components: a) Bolt; b) Indicating Disc; c) Socket for engaging bolt; d) Plate marked 'ENGAGED' and 'VACANT' oriented at 180 degrees.

The indicating plate must display clear, unambiguous visual signals to represent occupancy status: a) When the bolt is drawn (locked), it must show the word 'ENGAGED' on a solid red background; b) When the bolt is withdrawn (unlocked), it must show the word 'VACANT' on a solid green background.

The body, knob, and indicating spindle must be manufactured from one of the following specified materials: Aluminium alloy casting, Extruded aluminium alloy, Brass casting, Extruded brass, or Zinc base alloy die casting.
The indicating disc must be fabricated utilizing: Extruded aluminium alloy, Extruded brass, or Zinc base alloy die casting.
For gear-operated indicating bolts, the internal gears must be manufactured from: Brass casting, Extruded brass, or Zinc base alloy die casting.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 4621 : 1975 is the national Indian Standard specification regulating indicating bolts used on doors in public baths, restrooms, and lavatories to indicate occupancy. It classifies bolts into Size 1 and Size 2 and permits operation via either internal gear work or mechanical sliding displacement. The standard mandates strict visual signaling: when the bolt is engaged, the plate must display the word 'ENGAGED' on a bold red background; when retracted, it must display 'VACANT' on a green background. To ensure mechanical reliability, it restricts materials for internal components, body castings, and indicating discs to highly durable copper-alloys (brass), corrosion-resistant aluminum alloys, or die-cast zinc alloys, preventing premature latch failure in humid environments.
